title: Two Sum
story: The classic opener. Given numbers and a target, find the two positions that add up to it.
goal: Write two_sum(nums, target): return the two indexes [i, j] with i < j whose numbers add up to target. Exactly one pair exists.
hints: The slow way checks every pair. A dict from value to index can find the partner in one step.
For each number, the partner is target - number. Was it seen before?
socratic: What number would complete this one?
How can you remember what you have already seen?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Two Sum”?
